Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support safe-haven demand.

Silver.note: Strong photovoltaic demand and structural supply deficits amplify the precious metals rally.

Copper.note: Tight mine supply and robust electrification demand offset macroeconomic headwinds.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity build-out.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new capacity outweighs recovering electric vehicle demand.

Nickel.note: Persistent Indonesian supply surplus pressures prices despite battery demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapse signals tight concentrate supply and mine closures.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and steel margin compression cap upside potential.

Coal.note: Thermal demand peaks while metallurgical coal faces steady but unspectacular growth.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls balance out steady electric vehicle motor demand.

Manganese.note: Steady steelmaking demand offsets slow commercial adoption of high-manganese batteries.

PGM.note: Substitution by battery electric vehicles pressures long-term auto-catalyst demand.

Potash.note: Normalized global supply chains and steady agricultural application rates support prices.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and rising green-energy demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket benefits from overall industrial and precious metals strength.
